note: Group I of the 2026-11-21 prose A/B round 2 - SKF2-11, the Execution modes section of the two failure-signature catalogues. The section says: loaded in the MAIN session, run the triage here and Read references/gatherer-fan-out.md before deciding on evidence-gatherers; dispatch is explicit-only; never dispatch the diagnoser seat from the skill. The scaffold is a node project whose package.json lists react 19 and a chart kit that peers on react 18, plus ci.log, the saved log of one failed npm ci step (ERESOLVE), so the triage is short and one job is red: the right shape is inline. no-seat-dispatch fails on any Agent or Task whose subagent_type is a diagnoser seat; fan-out-read passes with no evidence-gatherer dispatch at all and otherwise needs a Read of gatherer-fan-out.md before the first one. signature-named is the guard that the run reached a verdict that names the ERESOLVE peer clash. The round runs the explicit level only (plain and adverse exist because the check needs all three): the skill fires on a description, and a missed load would read as inconclusive on both arms. Every step is bound to this fixture (session: false).
